summary: Full stack testing of Company Profile Platform. Backend: 21/21 pytest cases passed covering auth (register/login/me), company CRUD, logo/cover/media uploads to Emergent Object Storage, media delete, password change with revert/relogin, email/phone change request stage, and public profile (auth-not-required, owner_id + _id stripped). Frontend: Playwright e2e covered register-> dashboard, profile edit (phone/address/description) + save persistence, tab switching, gallery multi-upload with delete flow, logo upload, account settings (email change moves to verify stage, phone change moves to verify stage, wrong password shows Georgian error toast, correct password succeeds), and public profile /company/{id} rendering company name without auth. Email/phone code confirmation not asserted (per instructions – code not readable from inbox).

minor.issue: Endpoint returns 200 even when Resend email delivery fails (send_verification_email swallows exceptions). Verification row is still created. Consider surfacing a warning to client when send fails.
New password minimum length (6) is validated AFTER current-password check; not a bug but consider returning a friendly 422 with field errors.

issues: Phone-change flow sends verification code to the user's current EMAIL (not SMS to the new phone). This is the backend behavior (send_verification_email(user.email)) and the toast text 'დადასტურების კოდი გაიგზავნა მეილზე' matches, but the UI copy could clarify to end users.

action_items: Optional: surface email-send failures from /api/account/request-email-change (currently silently succeeds if Resend rejects).
Optional: clarify AccountSettings phone-change UI copy that the code goes to the current email, not the new phone number.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~420 lines with auth, company CRUD, media, account security in one file. Splitting into routers (auth, company, media, account) would improve maintainability (>300 lines threshold).
put_object/get_object use synchronous requests inside async endpoints (potential event loop blocking under load). Consider httpx.AsyncClient for storage calls.
public_company() mutates the input dict (in-place pop). Fine for one-shot use but could bite if the doc is cached.

CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True which is invalid per CORS spec; browsers will reject credentialed requests when origin is wildcard. Not an issue today because the app uses Bearer tokens (no cookies), but flag it if cookies are ever added.
No rate-limiting or lockout on /api/auth/login (brute-force allowed).
Content-type of uploaded media is trusted only via extension check; safe enough but consider magic-byte sniffing.
test_credentials: Registered fresh company each run via UI/API (uitest_<random>@test.com / test123). Also verified existing pattern.
seed_data_creation: None persisted intentionally; UI test created one company (uitest_2c24fb36@test.com) and backend tests created one per run with TEST_ prefix in names.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite is at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — uses module-scoped fixture with a random email so it is idempotent. Run with: `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -n 0 --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. pytest.ini enforces `-n 2 --dist loadscope`, so pass `-n 0` for a single run. Email/phone verification-code confirm cannot be tested end-to-end because the code is emailed via Resend; only the request stage is asserted. All storage uploads succeed against Emergent Object Storage (STORAGE_URL) using EMERGENT_LLM_KEY. Frontend base URL: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs found requiring RCA.
